title: The night walk
goals: Reach the way down to the dormitory.
Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code:
# A dark room, a locked door, a moving stair, and Dask below.
# Put everything you have learned together to safely reach the dormitory.
hints: Light the room, pick up the key, and open the door.
Wait by the edge until the moving stair is in place.
Before going down the last steps, wait for Dask to look away.
intro: This is it, {wizard}. We are almost back to the dormitory. There is a dark room, a moving stair, and Dask walking below. We have to use everything we know.
outro: We made it to the way down to the dormitory! But wait... I can hear footsteps right behind us.
